Containerization means:

• Easier scalability.
• Simplified movement across different environments.
• CI/CD practices enablement.

items.description: to perform UI updates, simple code conversions and cloud migrations

timelines.costDescription: The total cost of application modernization can range from $10,000–$15,000 for a UI upgrade or rehosting of a small app to $50,000–$250,000 for a substantial modernization of a medium/large app. If extensive reengineering, deep recoding, or implementation of advanced techs (e.g., big data, AI/ML) is required, the cost may reach $500,000+ for a large application.
costFactors: The complexity of applications and their dependencies.
The volume of data to transfer.
The life span of the application and its cloud migration readiness; the scope of infrastructure, code and configuration changes required.
The extent of modernization automation and the cost of the relevant software licenses (e.g., code conversion tools).

faq.title: Answering Frequent Questions about Application Modernization

questions.question: What is the biggest factor in deciding to start the modernization process for an application?
questions.answer: The main trigger is usually high maintenance costs combined with poor performance, security risks, or inability to scale. When the cost of keeping an old system exceeds the cost of modernizing it —, that's when companies act.

questions.question: Is it possible to modernize a legacy app with no detailed documentation (functional specifications)?
questions.answer: Yes, absolutely. We specialize in reverse engineering and documentation recovery. We analyze code, database schemas, and user behavior to reconstruct requirements.

questions.question: How can I be sure that the modernized app will bring the expected results instead of only wasting the company's time and resources?
questions.answer: We use a risk-based approach with clear milestones, KPIs, and regular demos. You see working software from week 4, and we guarantee business value delivery or money back.

questions.question: Can we modernize legacy applications without operational downtime?
questions.answer: Yes. We use blue-green deployment, feature toggles, and parallel run strategies to ensure zero downtime during migration.

questions.question: Is it possible to avoid long freeze-up of the apps during modernization?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We modernize in small, safe increments with continuous integration and automated testing.
